appName.description: Name of the MuleSoft application as it appears in Anypoint Runtime Manager.

environment.description: Anypoint Platform environment where the app is running (e.g. Production, Staging, Development).

jiraTicketId.description: Optional Jira ticket ID to link assessment results back to a migration tracking ticket.

branch.description: Optional. Explicit branch to assess for this request. Highest precedence — overrides the registry default and the repository's discovered default branch.

owner.description: Optional GitHub owner/org override (used only when the app is not in the registry).

repo.description: Optional GitHub repository name override (used only when the app is not in the registry).

appPath.description: Optional path to the Mule module within the repo (e.g. "." for repo root).

orgId.description: Optional Anypoint organization ID override (used only when the app is not in the registry).
